title: Appending consecutive tape words
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $[?m$ be a symbol alphabet, let $P,S$ be state sets, and fix an input word. For a configuration $d$, tape $i$, words $u,v$, states $q,r\in P$, and a state map $f:P\to S$, consider the operation that sets the state to the specified state, writes the word at the current head position and advances that head by its length. Advancing first by $u$ to state $q$, renaming states by $f$, and then advancing by $v$ to state $r$ gives the same configuration as first renaming the state of $d$ by $f$ and then advancing by the concatenation $u\mathbin{+[?m}v$ to state $r$.
hypotheses_covered: a configuration $d$ on a fixed input over alphabet $\Gamma$ with state set $P$
